objective: Evaluate modern LLM serving by preparing small LLM weights and measuring hybrid speed.
success_criteria: Prepare a small LLM-shaped weight fixture without adding a large trained model or generated binary as source of truth.
Use the fixture in the hybrid evaluation path, not only as a disconnected artifact.
Run CPU and hybrid measurements and compare correctness with the repository's coverage-output policy.
Record timing and identify whether hybrid is faster for the measured serving-like condition.
Preserve the distinction between RTL proxy serving evaluation and full model/token-generation inference.

prompt_to_artifact_checklist.verification: The fixture is deterministic, int4-packed, 7168 bytes, and recorded by manifest SHA-256.

prompt_to_artifact_checklist.prompt_item: weights are connected to hybrid evaluation
prompt_to_artifact_checklist.verification: Selected attn_q, attn_k, and attn_v byte ranges from the manifest are hashed and mapped into pulp_quantized_kv_cache proxy stimulus/configuration.

The first fixture-derived 1x1 smoke run passes with 4.28x hybrid-wall speedup. The 1x1 tensor-stream runs are mixed. The 32x1 state-parallel tensor-stream runs all pass and are faster on hybrid wall time.
All selected comparisons pass coverage-output equivalence with zero coverage-output mismatches.
The evaluation uses attention tensor streams and quantized KV-cache proxy behavior. It does not claim token generation or full model inference.

completion_rationale: The explicit user request to prepare small LLM weights and evaluate hybrid speed is satisfied at the repository's current RTL-proxy level: a deterministic small weight fixture exists, selected tensor byte ranges drive the proxy, CPU-vs-hybrid correctness comparisons pass, and timing is recorded. The completion is not a full LLM inference claim.
residual_non_claims: not HuggingFace or MLPerf numerical equivalence
not model quality, perplexity, or accuracy
not broad hybrid speedup beyond the measured proxy streams
future_work_not_blocking_completion: stream all fixture tensors instead of selected attention tensors
download or import a trained small model under an explicit license gate
compare against a model-level CPU inference runtime
